test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A new scooter is valued at ₹1,20,000. At the end of each year, its value is reduced by 12% of its value at the start of the year. What will be its value (in ₹) after 2 years?
solution:
Formula:

A = P × (1 - Rover 100)T

where-

P = Present price

R = Rate of depriciation

T = Time

A = Price after T years
